summary: Faithful implementation of the design across all 5 features: build clean (0 tsc strict errors), 156/156 tests pass, Round-3 MEDIUM-1/2/3 + safeEqual auth + graceful degradation + disjoint alert conditions + zod validation all correctly realized; no HIGH/MEDIUM findings.

findings.title: readLogsTail may over-read for stream='all' tail accuracy
findings.problem: For stream='all' each file is tailed to `clamped` lines independently then merged and sliced to the last `clamped` by ts. Lines lacking an embedded timestamp get a synthesized ts (now - tail.length + i) per file, so interleave ordering across the two files is approximate when neither carries real timestamps. This is within the design's stated 'embedded/estimated timestamp, falling back to read order' tolerance and bounded-tail scope, so it is cosmetic.
findings.fix: No change required for v1; if exact cross-stream ordering is ever needed, carry per-file read offsets into a shared monotonic estimator. Documented bounded-tail behavior already covers this.

findings.title: Digest alert counters are a lifetime tally, not a 24h window
findings.problem: The digest 'alerts dispatched/suppressed' counters accumulate for the whole process lifetime (incremented on every 'alert' event) rather than resetting per 24h digest period, and cooldown-suppressed matches are not counted (they never emit an 'alert' event). This matches the design's explicitly-labeled approximation and the FEAT-003/004 findings, so it is not a defect against the spec.
findings.fix: Optional: reset the counters inside DigestScheduler.fire() after building the payload to make them per-period, or add a dedicated engine counter for cooldown-suppressed matches. Not required by the acceptance criteria.
